setup.title: Initial isaacli setup
language.title: Choose the interface language
language.note: Isaac will answer in the language used by the user.
select.invalid: Choose one of the displayed options.
engine.title: Choose Isaac's engine
engine.explain: The engine can run locally with Ollama or remotely through an API.
engine.ollama: Local Ollama · models run on this computer
engine.api: OpenAI-compatible API · configurable endpoint and model
api.title: Configure an OpenAI-compatible API
api.explain: The conversation and tool schemas are sent to the selected endpoint. Commands and files are still executed locally by Isaac's sandbox.
api.key.prompt: Paste the API key (input is hidden):
api.key.missing: The API key was not provided.
api.fields.missing: Provider name, endpoint and model are required.
api.retry.title: Review the API details
thinking.api.title: Choose the reasoning setting sent to the API
thinking.api.explain: Choose disabled if the model does not accept reasoning_effort; GPT-OSS accepts low, medium or high.
ollama.missing.title: Ollama is not installed
ollama.missing.explain: Ollama is the local engine that runs Isaac models.
ollama.install.linux:
Official Linux installation:
  curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
ollama.install.macos: Download the official macOS installer from https://ollama.com/download
ollama.install.windows: Download the official Windows installer from https://ollama.com/download
ollama.server.starting: Ollama is installed but its server is not running. Starting it temporarily...
ollama.server.failed: Could not start the Ollama server.
model.title: Choose the model that will power Isaac
model.recommended.explain:
Ollama ready — version {version}
Initial recommendations target GPUs such as a 4 GB GTX or better. More powerful GPUs may have other good options not yet shown in this catalog.
model.download.running: Downloading {model}. This may take a few minutes...
model.tools.missing: Model {model} does not provide tools and cannot power Isaac.
context.title: Choose the context size
context.explain: Context is shared by instructions, tools, history, request, thinking and response. It is not the reasoning level.
context.standard: Standard — 16K · a good starting point for agents
context.long: Long — 32K · more history and more memory
thinking.qwen.title: Qwen Instruct reasoning
thinking.qwen.explain: This Instruct variant does not emit separate thinking. Continue with the recommended mode or choose another model.
thinking.qwen.change: Go back and choose a thinking model
thinking.gpt.title: Choose the reasoning level
thinking.gpt.explain: Reasoning controls how much the model thinks before answering and is separate from context. The highlighted option is the recommended default.
model.create.failed: Could not create the model profile (exit code {code}).
